title: Add Two Numbers
constraints: Each linked list has 1 to 100 nodes
Numbers do not have leading zeros
inputFormat:
Implement addTwoNumbers(l1, l2). Inputs below show JavaScript function arguments; there is no stdin parsing.
Linked lists use value arrays. The editor passes nodes with val and next properties; [] becomes null.
outputFormat:
Return the result described in the statement.
Returned list heads are displayed as value arrays; a null head is [].
